themes.name: Housing Affordability and Renovation
themes.rule: Include proposals that increase, preserve, finance, regulate, or provide information about affordable housing, rentals, apartments, dormitories, or residential energy upgrades.

themes.name: Schools and Student Support
themes.rule: Include proposals focused on school staffing, class conditions, facilities, tutoring, meals, or children’s educational and arts instruction.

themes.name: Health and Care Access
themes.rule: Include proposals that expand medical appointments, clinics, preventive screening, mental-health support, or in-home care.

themes.name: Transit and Safe Mobility
themes.rule: Include proposals about public-transit fares, schedules, tracking, or capacity, as well as cycling infrastructure and street-safety measures for travelers.

themes.name: Digital City Access
themes.rule: Include proposals that improve access to municipal services, government information, internet connectivity, or assistance using digital services.

themes.name: Jobs and Small Businesses
themes.rule: Include proposals that support workers, local hiring, business licensing, small-business finance, or workspaces for independent workers.

themes.name: Waste, Energy, and Air Quality
themes.rule: Include proposals that reduce pollution or resource use through clean energy, recycling, composting, plastic restrictions, or air-quality monitoring.

themes.name: Green Spaces and Neighborhood Amenities
themes.rule: Include proposals that create or improve trees, parks, gardens, playgrounds, dog areas, libraries, museums, public art, or outdoor cultural events.

themes.name: Public Safety and Emergency Response
themes.rule: Include proposals that improve emergency-service response, crime prevention, neighborhood policing, surveillance, or lighting for personal safety.
